scope: Frozen attempt provenance; full NET NOT_ACCEPTED; no Enforce authorization.

projectionRules.roles: Four complete bulk fields omitted with canonical identities. Declared compact role projections keep all joins and ShotProof; Long2 Shot selection covers source-positive/funded keys plus invalidity chronology; Long8 raw Shot-detail selection covers every funded key while all other positive/contradictory authority certificate/ShotProof rows remain complete. Facts wholly omitted with type counts; every timing/transport window retained in declared numeric columns. No silent row cap.
projectionRules.text: Full text retained except declared long-server-log line projection (first20/last30/all diagnostic matches); exact original indices/hash/counts preserved. Chunked if needed.
projectionRules.encoding: Deterministic compact UTF-8 JSON, Unicode retained, final newline; 128Ki-character lossless text chunks, <=1MiB encoded, contiguous byte ranges/full projection digest.
projectionRules.excluded: No game assets, binary/runtime files, Paths.txt/profiles, recordings or media copied.
